Messages.Author: XZealot
Messages.Body: I am looking for an official response from Pascal.

Messages.Author: Pascal Bertrand
Messages.Body:
> XZealot wrote:
> Can a Nocturn play Delaying Tactics?
>
No.
Similarly:
Ossian cannot play Impundulu,
Gregory Winter cannot play Ghouled when recruiting Carlton,
Warghoul cannot play Channeling the Beast.

Messages.Author: Klaital
Messages.Body: Allies can never play cards that cost blood, except for specific disciplines that might be allowed by the allys card text.

Messages.Author: jamesatzephyr
Messages.Body:
> Klaital wrote:
> Allies can never play cards that cost blood, except for specific disciplines that might be allowed by the allys card text.
>
Shadow Court Satyr can use a disciplineless card as a vampire as if played from your hand, if it requires a vampire (e.g. costs blood). Unlikely to be a game-winning strategy, but potentially possible in draft.
